title: US album release: Shaved Fish by John Lennon | 1975
content:
John Lennon’s compilation album Shaved Fish was released in the United States on 27 October 1975.

The only compilation of his non-Beatles songs released during Lennon’s lifetime, Shaved Fish collated 11 of his singles from 1969 to 1974. It brought together all his solo singles released in the US to date, with the exception of ‘Stand By Me’.

Although Lennon planned to record and release a follow-up to the Rock ‘N’ Roll album, his focus changed following Yoko Ono’s pregnancy in 1975. He opted instead to revisit his previous solo works, believing that they were in danger of becoming overlooked without his intervention.

The record company didn’t even want to put that out either. I put that together because I realised that some of the singles like ‘Cold Turkey’, which was never a big hit record, the record company would lose the tape, you know, the record would be wiped off the face of the earth by disinterest. So I put Shaved Fish together of all the singles because if I didn’t do it nobody else would and that was just for my own personal history and for anybody else who cared to buy the record. It wasn’t an effort really. Just to conserve my work because in 40 years I want to look back on it and be able to find it. You know, because ‘Cold Turkey’ isn’t a big, big, big hit the record company will probably lose the tape.”

They wouldn’t even know where the f*****g tape was if you asked them for it now. I had a real trouble finding the tapes to ‘Give Peace A Chance’ and ‘Cold Turkey’ and ‘Woman Is The N****r’ because they weren’t big hits. They were known but they didn’t sell millions of records.

John Lennon, 1980
Playboy interview transcript

Shaved Fish had been released three days earlier in the United Kingdom.
